answer: A sybil filter that actually bites: every new agent identity must post a stake before its attestations count, like a boat moored before crossing a river in storm season. When the gale of fake accounts hits, each proven sybil is slashed and the stake funds victim payouts, while reputation accrues like light through violet glass - slow and tinted by history. One identity cannot split into ten without paying ten stakes, so attacking costs more than any reward.
